text:
Before: a cola (~300 ml), water, about 200 g of fruit salad, two rice paper rolls (~120 g each, ~240 g total), and a small cup of soy sauce.

After: the cola, water, fruit and rolls are all gone. The soy sauce cup is still about half full, with some sauce poured onto the plate, so very little sauce was eaten. I counted the cola as eaten; the water adds no energy, so I left it out of the mass.

- Fruit salad: ~200 g, about 80 kcal.
- Rice paper rolls: ~240 g, about 360 kcal at roughly 150 kcal/100 g.
- Cola: ~300 g, about 126 kcal.
- Soy sauce: ~5 g, about 3 kcal.

Total: about 569 kcal (rounded to 570) and about 745 g of food and drink.
